hardware: AMD Radeon(TM) Graphics (0x1636), ANGLE D3D11; browser reports 12 logical cores, 16 GB
environment: Local Vite production preview port 3410, WebGL2, MSAA4, live water and icebergs, fixed quality during measurement
method: 100 synchronized frames over five fixed poses, three warmup frames per pose, followed by a visible 6-second camera orbit. Complete scene + reflection when scheduled + silhouette + overlay. Normal animation loop suppressed during benchmark. GPU query medians and p95; FPS from requestAnimationFrame.

payloadModel.compression: gzip for JS/CSS/HTML/JSON; WASM served uncompressed in this preview. Binary .gz and KTX2 unchanged. Estimates exclude HTTP headers. First load modeled from observed requested assets; not total dist folder.

limits: Single desktop machine; mobile viewport uses the same AMD GPU, DPR1. Not validation on a real phone or DPR2/3.
Each condition measured once; FPS is not a cross-device guarantee. Other user applications remained open.
Local cached loading is not WAN or slow-network timing. Default desktop progressive loading also requests 8m before 4m; add both terrain payloads.
GPU memory is partial terrain allocation only; excludes render targets, framebuffer, icebergs, material textures and driver overhead.
Triangle and draw-call counts include multiple render passes in the sampled frame, not unique terrain polygons; reflection passes vary across frames.
No WebGL warning/error logs captured during the last production test.
findings: Outline increases measured GPU median 47.3% in Brown8m: 7.66 to 11.28ms. Disable/optimize this optional pass first.
Brown4m terrain allocation ~35.88MiB vs ~10.03MiB at8m; first local terrain ~2.56s vs0.93s.
Current live counter previously reported only overlay triangles; corrected to sum a complete frame. Old bench bypassed outline; corrected.
Viewer mounts immediately after WebGL check; no offscreen IntersectionObserver suspension.
No complete destroy lifecycle for host-site unmount: renderer, controls, worker, observer, shared textures and window listeners need coordinated cleanup.
WASM compression and long-term caching should be configured in production hosting.
priorities: Integrate lazy mounting near viewport or on user interaction, offscreen pause, explicit destroy lifecycle.
Prefer 8m mobile with adaptive resolution. Keep 4m desktop optional/progressive after real-device validation.
Optimize or disable optional outline on constrained devices; preserve materials and geometry.
Test a real mid-range phone and a throttled mobile connection before publication.
